list.title: Data Breaches
list.description: Maintain the PDPA breach register and notification evidence. {{count}} incident(s) recorded.

empty.title: No data breaches recorded
empty.description: Record an incident to assess notification duties and start the breach register.

create.title: Record a data breach
create.description: Capture the incident facts, run the Malaysia PDPA notification assessment, and record the authorized human decision.
create.noPermission: You can view breach records, but you do not have permission to create one.

detail.description: Review the assessment, deadlines, notification evidence, and incident history.
detail.readOnly: You have read-only access to this incident.

reasons.CREDIT_OR_PROPERTY_DAMAGE: Potential damage to credit or property
reasons.ILLEGAL_USE: Potential illegal use of personal data

summary.title: Notification assessment
summary.description: The system recommendation is calculated from the recorded facts. An authorized person must separately record the notification decision.

transition.title: Incident status
transition.description: Advance or reopen the incident. Every change is appended to the status history.
transition.readOnly: You do not have permission to change the incident status.
transition.closeRequirement: Before closing, record every notification required by the system recommendation or the authorized human decision.

incident.title: Incident details
incident.description: Record when the breach occurred, when it became known, the affected scope, and response actions.

harm.title: Significant-harm assessment
harm.description: Select every potential consequence supported by the current incident facts.

potentialPhysicalHarm.label: Potential physical harm
potentialPhysicalHarm.help: The breach may cause bodily harm, safety risks, or related physical consequences.

potentialFinancialLoss.label: Potential financial loss
potentialFinancialLoss.help: The breach may expose a person to theft, fraud, or other financial loss.

potentialCreditOrPropertyDamage.label: Potential credit or property damage
potentialCreditOrPropertyDamage.help: The breach may damage a person's credit record, property, or financial standing.

potentialIllegalUse.label: Potential illegal use
potentialIllegalUse.help: The personal data may be used for an unlawful purpose.

sensitivePersonalData.label: Sensitive personal data involved
sensitivePersonalData.help: The affected data includes sensitive personal data under the PDPA.

potentialIdentityFraud.label: Potential identity fraud
potentialIdentityFraud.help: The breach may enable impersonation or identity fraud.

decision.title: Authorized notification decision
decision.description: Record the responsible person's decision separately from the system recommendation. The platform does not notify the Commissioner automatically.

notifications.title: Notification and evidence
notifications.description: Record submission, confirmation, late-notification evidence, and data-subject communication.

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: Summarize what happened and what is currently known.

occurredAt.label: Occurred at
occurredAt.help: Optional when the exact occurrence time is unknown.

discoveredAt.label: Discovered at
discoveredAt.help: When the organization first detected the incident.

awarenessAt.label: Awareness at
awarenessAt.help: The regulatory trigger used for the 72-hour deadline.

affectedDataSubjects.label: Affected data subjects
affectedDataSubjects.help: More than 1,000 triggers the significant-scale test.

affectedDataRecords.label: Affected data records
affectedDataRecords.help: Estimated number of individual records involved.

personalDataTypes.label: Personal data types
personalDataTypes.help: List the categories of personal data involved.

notificationDecision.label: Notification decision
notificationDecision.help: This is the authorized human decision, not the system recommendation.

decisionRationale.label: Decision rationale
decisionRationale.help: Required after a decision other than pending is recorded.

decisionEvidence.label: Decision evidence
decisionEvidence.help: Reference minutes, legal advice, approvals, or other supporting evidence.

commissionerNotificationReference.label: Commissioner notification reference
commissionerNotificationReference.help: Required when the submission time is recorded.

delayedNotificationReason.label: Late-notification reason
delayedNotificationReason.help: Required when notification occurs more than 72 hours after awareness.

delayedNotificationEvidence.label: Late-notification evidence
delayedNotificationEvidence.help: Required together with the late-notification reason.

dataSubjectsNotificationEvidence.label: Data-subject notification evidence
dataSubjectsNotificationEvidence.help: Required when the data-subject notification time is recorded.

validation.contentTooLong: This field exceeds the maximum length.
validation.personalDataTypesRequired: Describe the personal data types involved.
validation.nonNegativeInteger: Enter a whole number of zero or more.
validation.occurredAfterDiscovery: The occurrence time cannot be after discovery.
validation.awarenessBeforeDiscovery: The awareness time cannot be before discovery.
validation.decisionRationaleRequired: Add a rationale for the recorded decision.
validation.commissionerBeforeAwareness: Commissioner notification cannot be before awareness.
validation.delayReasonRequired: Add the reason for notifying after 72 hours.
validation.delayEvidenceRequired: Add evidence supporting the late-notification reason.
validation.confirmationRequiresNotification: Record the Commissioner notification before its confirmation.
validation.confirmationBeforeNotification: Confirmation cannot be before Commissioner notification.
validation.dataSubjectsRequireCommissioner: Record the Commissioner notification before notifying data subjects.
validation.dataSubjectsBeforeCommissioner: Data-subject notification cannot be before Commissioner notification.

errors.create: Failed to record the data breach.
errors.update: Failed to update the data breach.
errors.transition: Failed to update the incident status.
